title: Task record
statement: Each task shall be stored as one `Task` record in the private database, with the fields below.

title: List record
statement: Each list shall be stored as one `TaskList` record, with the fields below.

title: Per-field timestamps
statement: Every record shall carry a modification time per field, and a merge shall keep, field by field, the value with the later time.
rationale: Whole-record last-writer-wins lost a title edit on one device when another ticked the same task off.
source: OQ-0402. **Reopened 2026-10-02**: a time per field, not per record.
